parsed.rationale: Two of the four participating records live in 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift', which is unambiguously a test target by its path, even though the pipeline's is_test flag reads false — likely a metadata gap. The other two records are 'Image' extensions in 'Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Models and Services/ImageCompatability.swift'. Because the CGImage extensions reside in a test file, extracting or merging them with the production Image extensions in Core would couple production code to test-support semantics. Additionally, all four records carry empty fields_or_signature lists, so there is no grounded evidence of what members are actually shared; acting on shape alone with shared_field_count: 1 and no visible member names is insufficient to justify a structural change.
